aliases: enslavement path true inheritance of the Corpse Emperor

summary.text: Corpse Emperor true inheritance appears on Corpse Emperor Yu Ding Tian after qi tides expose hidden inheritances in Southern Border.

claims.text: Corpse Emperor Yu Ding Tian is a corpse mountain thousands of feet tall beside the whirlpool where red dragon river and yellow dragon river meet. A rank eight Southern Border Gu Immortal had turned into an immortal zombie, fought allied super forces there, and died; river essence and aquatic plants turned the mangled corpse into the mountain, which produces transformation path zombie Gu and qi path zombie qi Gu. Wu clan refused to sell it to Zombie Alliance as a headquarters site, later lost it to Yao clan, and Wu Yong took it back with Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building.

Traces on the mountain show a true inheritance left by that rank eight immortal zombie. The Fierce Gorge Seven Ghosts name it Corpse Emperor true inheritance, accuse Wu Zhen of concealing it, and fall into Wu Yong’s cardinal directional wind formation trap while trying to take it.

Wu Zhan Ping lists this as one of three high-value true inheritances Wu Yong takes out to nurture Wu clan descendants. He names the dead immortal Corpse Emperor: a demonic path rank eight who turned himself into a zombie near the end of his lifespan, drew allied attacks by being ruthless, and whose immortal zombie body became the mountain. Wu Zhan Ping calls the find a rank eight enslavement path true inheritance that lacks Immortal Gu, and says Wu clan can supply the huge resources enslavement path needs. Wu Ji refuses it.

When Fang Yuan asks to buy famous mountains including Corpse Emperor Yu Ding Tian, Wu Yong refuses: Wu clan needs that mountain and Corpse Mountain, and not long ago obtained the enslavement path true inheritance of the Corpse Emperor, which the clan is trying to develop and use.
